correctness.rationale: For every odd p>=5 and arbitrary characteristic-p field K, R_p quandle product in K[t]/(t^p-1) equals iota(f) sigma(g). Since J=(t-1) has J^p=0, no nonzero augmentation-zero idempotent survives, and the truncated exp/log are mutually inverse additive/multiplicative maps on J and 1+J. Linearized idempotence is u=iota(u)+sigma(u); splitting into +/- inversion eigenspaces gives iota u=-u and sigma u=2u. Doubling residue cycles and inversion pairing give dim_K W=(p-1)/lcm(2,ord_p 2). Exp(u)star Exp(v)=Exp(-u+2v), yielding the all-field vector-space core and finite-field count q^d+1. Independent arithmetic verified p=17 dimension 2/count 290, p=31 dimension 3/count 29792, and direct finite-field coefficient checks for p=5,7 parameter specializations. The symbolic linearization proves the full any-field claim beyond tests.
